newsitem.title: UK: Select Appointments confident on yr outlook.
newsitem.headline: Select Appointments confident on yr outlook.

text.p: British-based recruitment firm Select Appointments (Holdings) Plc, posting a 72 percent rise in first-quarter profits, said on Tuesday its trading since March 31 was in line with previous trends.
The company's pretax profit surged to 6.1 million stg in the first quarter ended on March 31 from 3.6 million stg in the year-ago period, boosted by strong growth in the U.S. and Britain.
"Trading since March 31 has been encouraging and in line with previous trends," the company said in its earnings statement. "We remain confident of the outlook for the year."
Select's shares rose 10p to 385 by 0815 GMT.
